stories.headline: IEA: Iran War Will Cause First Annual Oil Demand Decline Since COVID-19 Pandemic

key_facts.fact: IEA now projects global oil demand will contract by 80,000 bpd in 2026, a 730,000 bpd swing from its March forecast of 640,000 bpd growth
key_facts.excerpt: The Iran war has 'thoroughly upended the global outlook for oil consumption', the agency said, as it now predicts an 80,000 bpd drop in demand growth this year, from a 640,000 bpd rise in its March report.

key_facts.fact: A projected 1.5 million bpd drop in demand in Q2 2026 would mark the deepest quarterly contraction since the COVID-19 pandemic
key_facts.excerpt: Oil demand is expected to contract by 80 kb/d this year, as the Iran war upends our global outlook. This is 730 kb/d less than in last month's Report and a forecast 1.5 mb/d 2Q26 decline would be the sharpest since Covid-19 slashed fuel consumption.

key_facts.fact: Global oil supply plummeted by 10.1 million bpd in March to 97 million bpd — the largest supply disruption in history, according to the IEA
key_facts.excerpt: Attacks on regional energy infrastructure and the effective closure of the Strait of Hormuz led to a loss of 10.1 million bpd of supply in March, the agency said, calling it the largest oil supply disruption in history.

key_facts.fact: OPEC+ production fell 9.4 million bpd month-on-month to 42.4 million bpd; Middle East and Asia refineries cut crude runs by 6 million bpd in April
key_facts.excerpt: Global oil supply plummeted by 10.1 mb/d to 97 mb/d in March... OPEC+ production fell 9.4 mb/d m-o-m to 42.4 mb/d... In April, Middle East and feedstock-constrained refineries in Asia have cut runs by around 6 mb/d, to 77.2 mb/d.

key_facts.fact: In a worst-case scenario with prolonged disruptions, the IEA projects demand could fall 5 million bpd year-on-year and nearly 2 billion barrels would be drawn from stocks
key_facts.excerpt: The agency also presented a more severe scenario with longer-term supply disruptions, which could draw almost 2 billion barrels of oil from stocks and force demand to fall 5 million bpd year-on-year on average from the second quarter to the fourth quarter.

key_facts.fact: Deepest demand cuts so far have hit Middle East and Asia-Pacific, mainly naphtha, LPG, and jet fuel; demand destruction expected to spread as scarcity persists
key_facts.excerpt: 'Demand destruction will spread as scarcity and higher prices persist,' the IEA report said on Tuesday, adding that the deepest cuts in oil consumption have come from the Middle East and Asia Pacific so far, for naphtha, LPG and jet fuel in particular.

stories.headline: Amazon Agrees to Acquire Globalstar for $11.57B, Becomes Apple's Primary Satellite Provider

key_facts.fact: Amazon will pay $11.57 billion for Globalstar, or $90 per share in cash or Amazon stock, contingent on Globalstar meeting certain HIBLEO-4 replacement satellite milestones
key_facts.excerpt: Today Amazon.com, Inc. and Globalstar, Inc. announced that they have entered into a definitive merger agreement under which Amazon will acquire Globalstar.

key_facts.fact: As part of the deal, Amazon signed an agreement with Apple to become the primary satellite service provider for iPhone and Apple Watch, continuing existing out-of-cell-range connectivity
key_facts.excerpt: We've also signed an agreement with Apple to become their primary satellite service provider for iPhone and Apple Watch.

key_facts.fact: Amazon Leo (formerly Project Kuiper) aims to deploy over 7,700 LEO satellites but has only launched about 180 so far; Globalstar brings an existing operational satellite network and spectrum rights
key_facts.excerpt: Amazon's Project Kuiper lags, having launched only 241 of 1,600 planned satellites by 2026... Amazon's $9B Globalstar acquisition aims to accelerate infrastructure.

key_facts.fact: Apple holds a 20% equity stake in Globalstar and has reserved 85% of its network capacity for iPhone emergency services after investing ~$1.5B in 2024
key_facts.excerpt: Apple holds a 20% equity stake in Globalstar and has reserved 85% of its network capacity for its iPhone emergency services. This arrangement, worth over $1.5 billion in total, creates a significant integration hurdle.

key_facts.fact: The acquisition intensifies competition with SpaceX's Starlink, which has over 10 million active users, ~10,000 satellites in orbit, and is adding ~52,000 new users per day
key_facts.excerpt: SpaceX projects adding 52,000 new Starlink Mobile users per day throughout 2026, targeting 25 million active users by year-end.

key_facts.fact: Amazon also unveiled the Leo Aviation Antenna, delivering up to 1 Gbps download and 400 Mbps upload for in-flight Wi-Fi, with Delta Air Lines among early adopters
key_facts.excerpt: Amazon Leo shows off in-flight Wi-Fi antenna that will take on Starlink... delivering speeds up to 1 Gbps downlink and 400 Mbps uplink from a single antenna.

stories.headline: Markets Rally and Oil Falls Below $100 as Blockade Begins but US-Iran Dialogue Stays Alive

key_facts.fact: Brent crude fell nearly 2% to $97.50/barrel and WTI dropped 2.27% to $96.83 on Tuesday, reversing Monday's 4%+ spike, after both sides signaled openness to renewed talks
key_facts.excerpt: Brent futures declined by $1.86, or 1.87%, to $97.50, while US West Texas Intermediate (WTI) crude fell $2.25, or 2.27%, to $96.83 by 0003 GMT.

key_facts.fact: The S&P 500 rose 1% to close at 6,886 on Monday; Japan's Nikkei 225 surged 2.5% and South Korea's KOSPI jumped 3.7% on Tuesday
key_facts.excerpt: Japan's benchmark Nikkei 225 rose as much as 2.5 percent on Tuesday, while South Korea's KOSPI gained about 3.7 percent... The rally in Asia followed gains on Wall Street, with the benchmark S&P 500 finishing up 1 percent overnight.

key_facts.fact: The US blockade went into effect Monday at 5:30pm Iranian time; at least two tankers turned around, but a Chinese-owned tanker Rich Starry was the first to transit the strait after the blockade began
key_facts.excerpt: Shipping data on LSEG showed Chinese-owned oil-and-chemicals tanker Rich Starry passed through the strait on Tuesday - the first since the US blockade began.

key_facts.fact: Pakistan's PM Sharif said efforts were still underway to resolve the conflict; Trump said Iran had called and 'would like to make a deal very badly'
key_facts.excerpt: A US official said there was continued engagement and forward motion on trying to get to an agreement. Pakistani Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif also said efforts were still underway to resolve the conflict.

key_facts.fact: ANZ analysts estimate ~10 million bpd of crude supply has been removed from the market, with a prolonged blockade potentially curbing an additional 3-4 million bpd
key_facts.excerpt: ANZ analysts estimate that about 10 million barrels per day of crude supply have been effectively removed from the market, adding that a prolonged US blockade could curb an additional 3 million to 4 million bpd of crude shipments.

key_facts.fact: No NATO ally has joined the US blockade; the UK and France are co-hosting a 40+ nation summit this week to discuss restoring free transit through Hormuz independently
key_facts.excerpt: The UK will co-host an international summit of more than 40 nations this week to discuss how to safeguard shipping through the strait of Hormuz when the Iran conflict finally comes to an end.

stories.headline: China's YMTC Plans Two New Fabs to More Than Double NAND Flash Production Capacity

key_facts.fact: YMTC plans to build two additional factories beyond the third fab being completed this year; each of the three new fabs will have 100,000 wafers/month capacity at full build-out
key_facts.excerpt: Chinese chipmaker YMTC plans new factories amid heightened US-Sino trade tensions.

key_facts.fact: YMTC currently operates two fabs in Wuhan with 200,000 wafers/month combined capacity; all three new fabs will more than double total production when fully operational
key_facts.excerpt: Het niet-beursgenoteerde YMTC, China's grootste producent van NAND-flashgeheugenchips, beschikt momenteel over twee fabrieken die gezamenlijk 200.000 wafers per maand kunnen produceren.

key_facts.fact: The third fab's building is complete and equipment installation underway, with >50% of equipment sourced from domestic Chinese suppliers; production expected to start late 2026
key_facts.excerpt: Het gebouw is voltooid en het bedrijf is momenteel bezig met de installatie van apparatuur. Meer dan 50% van de apparatuur is afkomstig van binnenlandse bedrijven.

key_facts.fact: YMTC held 11.8% of the global NAND flash market in 2025 per UBS, projected to exceed 14% by early 2027; Samsung leads at 30.4%
key_facts.excerpt: YMTC was vorig jaar goed voor 11,8% van de wereldwijde NAND-flashmarkt, blijkt uit een rapport van UBS. Terwijl Samsung de markt aanvoert met 30,4%... UBS voorspelt dat het aandeel van YMTC tegen begin 2027 de 14% zal overschrijden.

key_facts.fact: All three new fabs will dedicate part of their capacity to DRAM production; YMTC has already sent LPDDR samples to customers and expects feedback by year-end
key_facts.excerpt: YMTC breidt tevens uit naar DRAM... Alle drie de nieuwe fabrieken zullen een deel van de capaciteit toewijzen aan de productie van DRAM... YMTC heeft monsters van LPDDR aan klanten gestuurd.

key_facts.fact: The expansion comes as the US MATCH Act proposes banning DUV lithography machine sales and maintenance to Chinese chipmakers including YMTC
key_facts.excerpt: The proposed 'MATCH Act' aims to prohibit the sale of older deep ultraviolet (DUV) machines to Chinese chipmakers like SMIC, Huawei, and YMTC... It would not only ban new hardware sales but also forbid performing maintenance or providing upgrades for DUV machines already operating in China.

stories.headline: EU's Iran War Energy Bill Hits €22B as Von der Leyen Calls Nuclear Phase-Out a 'Strategic Mistake'

key_facts.fact: The EU has spent an additional €22 billion on fossil fuels since the US-Israeli strikes on Iran began on February 28, amounting to roughly €500 million per day in extra costs
key_facts.excerpt: €500m per day is the extra cost of the Iran war to the EU's energy bill. The bloc has spent an additional €22bn since the start of the US-Israeli airstrikes against Tehran, according to the European Commission.

key_facts.fact: European Commission President von der Leyen said abandoning nuclear was a 'strategic mistake' and declared renewables and nuclear would be 'at the heart' of weaning Europe off oil and gas
key_facts.excerpt: Abandoning nuclear was a 'strategic mistake', she said last month. In a speech on Monday (13 April), she said that renewables and nuclear would be at the heart of weaning Europe off its dependency on oil and gas.

key_facts.fact: The European Commission is expected to approve France's plan to build six new reactors at a cost of €70 billion; several other EU states are unpicking legal moratoriums on nuclear energy
key_facts.excerpt: The commission is expected to green light France's plan to build six new reactors at a cost of €70bn, while a handful of other EU states are now unpicking their own legal moratoriums on nuclear energy.

key_facts.fact: Germany's coalition government agreed to give consumers and businesses about €1.6 billion in fuel price relief to respond to the oil price surge
key_facts.excerpt: In Germany, the coalition government agreed to give consumers and businesses about €1.6 billion of fuel price relief, ending a dispute over how to respond to the recent oil price surge.

key_facts.fact: ECB Vice President de Guindos said any ECB rate rise will depend on how war-driven surges in crude oil and chemical costs pass through to other prices
key_facts.excerpt: European Central Bank Vice President Luis de Guindos said any ECB interest rate rise will depend on how a war-fuelled surge in the cost of crude oil and some chemicals impacts other prices.

key_facts.fact: Several African countries including Tanzania and Kenya are bracing for 30% fuel price hikes at the pump due to the global energy disruption
key_facts.excerpt: Several African countries, including Tanzania and Kenya, are already bracing their people for 30-percent price hikes at the pump.

stories.headline: FDA Approves First-Ever Drug for FSGS Kidney Disease, Travere's Filspari

key_facts.fact: The FDA approved Filspari (sparsentan) as the first and only medicine ever approved for focal segmental glomerulosclerosis (FSGS), a rare kidney disease that scars filtering units
key_facts.excerpt: FILSPARI is the first and only medicine approved by the FDA for the treatment of FSGS, marking its expansion beyond IgA nephropathy (IgAN) into a second rare kidney disease.

key_facts.fact: The approval is for adults and children aged 8+ with FSGS without nephrotic syndrome, expanding Filspari's total addressable population to more than 100,000 patients in the US
key_facts.excerpt: Additional indication for FILSPARI expands total addressable population to more than 100,000 patients in the U.S, including more than 30,000 patients with FSGS.

key_facts.fact: In the Phase 3 DUPLEX study (371 patients), Filspari showed a 48% reduction in proteinuria at Week 108 in non-nephrotic patients vs 27% for irbesartan (p=0.0075)
key_facts.excerpt: Those without nephrotic syndrome who were treated with FILSPARI experienced a 48% reduction in proteinuria from baseline to Week 108 compared to 27% for those treated with irbesartan, which was statistically significant (nominal p-value, 0.0075).

key_facts.fact: Travere prices Filspari at $9,900/month (~$170,000/year) for IgAN; Jefferies expects peak FSGS sales to reach $961 million by 2033
key_facts.excerpt: Travere prices Filspari at $9,900 a month to treat IgA nephropathy, or about $170,000 a year. Jefferies analysts expect peak sales for the drug to reach $961 million by 2033.

key_facts.fact: FSGS affects more than 40,000 patients in the US with a similar prevalence in Europe; the disease can lead to kidney failure if untreated
key_facts.excerpt: FSGS is estimated to affect more than 40,000 patients in the U.S., with a similar prevalence in Europe.

key_facts.fact: Lucid secured $750 million in total new funding and named a new CEO as part of the announcement

key_facts.excerpt: Uber Technologies has begun early test rides of Lucid Gravity robotaxis equipped with Nuro's Level 4 autonomous driving technology in the San Francisco Bay Area.

key_facts.fact: Uber has committed to deploying up to 20,000 Lucid Gravity SUVs converted to robotaxis using Nuro's autonomous platform, with manufacturing expected to start at Lucid's Arizona factory late 2026
